LESSON: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building (2 sessions) • Vocabulary buildi
Topic 2.8: Reading Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Comprehension, part of Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building (2 sessions) • Vocabulary buildi in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading important? 2. How do direct questions help in understanding a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. articulate words on various parts of the body clearly and accurately,

2. list the names of parts of the body on flashcards in class,

3. work jointly to respond to direct questions from short texts,

4. match illustrations and names of parts of the body to their functions,

5. engage in reading activities for pleasure and comprehension. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. articulate words on various parts of the body clearly and accurately,
2. list the names of parts of the body on flashcards in class,
3. work jointly to respond to direct questions from short texts,
4. match illustrations and names of parts of the body to their functions,
5. engage in reading activities for pleasure and comprehension. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: This is enhanced as the learner follows simple instructions to respond to direct

questions from short texts.

• Learning to learn: This is nurtured as the learner builds on their own learning experiences when articulating words on

various body parts clearly and accurately.

35

Values:
Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner exhibits a self- driven attitude when engaging in reading activities for pleasure

and comprehension.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Issues of self-awareness: These are addressed as the learner interacts with texts and illustrations on parts of the body for self- awareness on functions of the parts of the body.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept about parts of the body to their learning of similar concepts in Science and Technology.
